arxiv-2503-06146.title: OpenRSD: Towards Open-prompts for Object Detection in Remote Sensing Images
arxiv-2503-06146.creator: Ziyue Huang, Yongchao Feng, Shuai Yang, Ziqi Liu, Qingjie Liu, Yunhong Wang
arxiv-2503-06146.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Ziyue Huang, Yongchao Feng, Shuai Yang, Ziqi Liu, Qingjie Liu, Yunhong Wang. Remote sensing object detection has made significant progress, but most studies still focus on closed-set detection, limiting generalization across diverse datasets. Open-vocabulary object detection (OVD) provides a solution by leveraging multimodal associations between text prompts and visual features.

arxiv-2505-23574.title: Si(100)-SiO 2 Trap Density Dependence on Sample Processing
arxiv-2505-23574.creator: Adam J. Czarnecki, Nikola L. Kolev, Patrick See, Nick Sullivan, Wyatt A. Behn, Neil J. Curson, Taylor J.Z. Stock, Peter Grütter
arxiv-2505-23574.description: Abstract As silicon-based devices continue to shrink to the nanoscale, traps at the Si-SiO 2 interface pose increasing challenges to device performance. These traps reduce channel carrier mobility and shift threshold voltages in integrated circuits, and introduce charge noise in quantum systems, reducing their coherence times.

arxiv-2510-15205.title: Toward Black–Scholes for Prediction Markets: A Unified Kernel and Market-Maker’s Handbook
arxiv-2510-15205.creator: Shaw Dalen Daedalus Research Team
arxiv-2510-15205.description: Abstract Prediction markets—exemplified by Polymarket and similar venues—aggregate dispersed information into tradable probabilities, yet they still lack the unifying stochastic kernel that options gained from Black–Scholes. As these markets scale (institutional participants, exchange integrations, and rising volumes around elections and macro prints), makers face belief–volatility, jump, and cross–event risks without standardized tools to quote or hedge them.

arxiv-2511-03931.title: Dynamic Shape Control of Soft Robots Enabled by Data-Driven Model Reduction
arxiv-2511-03931.creator: Iman Adibnazari 1 , Harsh Sharma 2 , Myungsun Park 1 , Jacobo Cervera-Torralba 1 , Boris Kramer 1 , Michael T. Tolley 1,3
arxiv-2511-03931.description: Abstract Soft robots have shown immense promise in settings where they can leverage dynamic control of their entire bodies. However, effective dynamic shape control requires a controller that accounts for the robot’s high-dimensional dynamics—a challenge exacerbated by a lack of general-purpose tools for modeling soft robots amenably for control.

pmc-11365536.title: Emerging Nanotherapeutic Approaches for Diabetic Wound Healing
pmc-11365536.creator: Shaoyan Shi, Leiming Hu, Dong Hu, Xuehai Ou, Yansheng Huang
pmc-11365536.description: Diabetic wounds pose a significant challenge in modern healthcare due to their chronic and complex nature, often resulting in delayed healing, infections, and, in severe cases, amputations. In recent years, nanotherapeutic approaches have emerged as promising strategies to address the unique pathophysiological characteristics of diabetic wounds.

pmc-11387635.title: Epidemiological analysis of a 10-year retrospective study of pediatric trauma in intensive care
pmc-11387635.creator: Yiyao Bao, Jing Ye, Lei Hu, Lijun Guan, Caina Gao, Linhua Tan
pmc-11387635.description: Pediatric trauma plays a crucial role in pediatric mortality, with traffic injuries and falls frequently cited as leading causes of significant injuries among children. A comprehensive investigation, including geographical factors, is essential for developing effective strategies to prevent injuries and alleviate the burden of pediatric trauma.

pmc-11651172.title: Suite of Biochemical and Cell-Based Assays for the Characterization of Kirsten Rat Sarcoma (KRAS) Inhibitors and Degraders
pmc-11651172.creator: Medhanie Kidane, Rene M. Hoffman, Jennifer K. Wolfe-Demarco, Ting-Yu Huang, Chi-Ling Teng, Saheli Samanta, Luis M. Gonzalez Lira, Jennifer Lin-Jones, Gabriel Pallares, Jane E. Lamerdin, Nicole B. Servant, Chun-Yao Lee, Chao-Tsung Yang, Jean A. Bernatchez
pmc-11651172.description: KRAS is an important oncogenic driver which is mutated in numerous cancers. Recent advances in the selective targeting of KRAS mutants via small molecule inhibitors and targeted protein degraders have generated an increase in research activity in this area in recent years.

pmc-11655891.title: Concordance of HER2 status between primary tumor and circulating tumor cells in breast cancer
pmc-11655891.creator: Peipei Xie, Xiaoli Zhang, Tianyi Liu, Yuchun Song, Qi Zhang, Duo Wan, Shijia Wang, Shulian Wang, Wen Zhang
pmc-11655891.description: BackgroundDuring tumor progression, HER2 expression undergoes dynamic changes. Circulating tumor cells (CTCs) can be used to monitor HER2 expression in real-time and hold potential for clinical application. This study aimed to evaluate the consistency of HER2 expression between primary tumors and CTCs in patients with breast cancer (BC).

pmc-11825829.title: Epidemiology of neonatal disorders attributable to low birthweight-global burden of disease research, 1990–2021
pmc-11825829.creator: Qi Zhang, Lan Luo, Lai-lai Yan, Jing Guo, Hui-jun Wu, Zi-wei Zhang, Yu-hua Zhu, Rui Qiao
pmc-11825829.description: BackgroundTo evaluate global, regional, and national trends in the burden of neonatal diseases attributable to LBW, as well as associated health inequalities, from 1990 to 2021.MethodsUsing data from the Global Burden of Disease Study (GBD2021), we analyzed deaths and DALYs due to LBW-attributable neonatal diseases. Data were stratified by gender, geographic region, epidemiological characteristics, and SDI levels.

pmc-12357909.title: A Comprehensive Polish Medical Speech Dataset for Enhancing Automatic Medical Dictation
pmc-12357909.creator: Andrzej Czyżewski, Sebastian Cygert, Karolina Marciniuk, Maciej Szczodrak, Arkadiusz Harasimiuk, Piotr Odya, Marina Galanina, Piotr Szczuko, Bożena Kostek, Beata Graff, Dariusz Szplit, Mariusz Budzisz, Krzysztof Narkiewicz
pmc-12357909.description: Pre-trained models have become widely adopted for their strong zero-shot performance, often minimizing the need for task-specific data. However, specialized domains like medical speech recognition still benefit from tailored datasets. We present ADMEDVOICE, a novel Polish medical speech dataset, collected using a high-quality text corpus and diverse recording conditions to reflect real-world scenarios.

pmc-12423662.title: Markerless 2D/3D image guidance vs. 2D fluoroscopy in posterior pedicle screw fixation using intraoperative 2D imaging: An experimental study
pmc-12423662.creator: Benno Bullert, Eric Mandelka, Paul A. Gruetzner, Sven Y. Vetter, Jula Gierse
pmc-12423662.description: IntroductionPosterior fixation with pedicle screws (PS) is a standard procedure in spine surgery. While 3D navigation enhances accuracy and minimizes radiation exposure, the high technical demands and costs typically restrict its use to specialized centers. A potential alternative is markerless 2D/3D image guidance, which enables precise 3D guidance using a standard 2D C-arm.

pmc-12438143.title: Longitudinal observational study of resting-state brain functional connectivity changes in anorexia nervosa post-treatment
pmc-12438143.creator: S Yennampelli, P Holštajn Zemánková
pmc-12438143.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). IntroductionAltered brain functional connectivity (FC) of patients with anorexia nervosa (AN) has been observed in the acute phase of the disorder, but it remains unclear to what extent these alterations recover during weight normalization.ObjectivesIn this study, we used resting-state functional imaging data collected during hospitalization and six months post-treatment to investigate longitudinal changes in FC patterns in patients with AN during weight normalization.

pmc-12536469.title: Electrochemical cyclization of alkynes to construct five-membered nitrogen-heterocyclic rings
pmc-12536469.creator: Lifen Peng, Ting Wang, Zhiwen Yuan, Bin Li, Zilong Tang, Xirong Liu, Hui Li, Guofang Jiang, Chunling Zeng, Henry N C Wong, Xiao-Shui Peng, Chao Li
pmc-12536469.description: Organic five-membered rings have shown significant applications in the fields of organic synthesis, natural products, organic materials and pharmaceuticals for their unique characteristics. Electrochemical construction of five-membered rings from alkynes attracted increasing attention due to the notable advantages of electrochemical transformations and facile access of alkynes.

pmc-12603385.title: Volatile Organic Compound Emissions From Solidago altissima Under Experimental Warming and Drought
pmc-12603385.creator: Kara C. Dobson, Phoebe L. Zarnetske
pmc-12603385.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Plant volatile organic compound (VOC) emissions are important mediators for plant interactions with biotic and abiotic factors in the environment. Changes in VOC emissions can be caused by factors associated with climate change, such as warming and drought. However, we currently lack an understanding of how warming and drought affect plants' emissions in their natural environment, let alone how these climate factors may interact to synergistically affect emissions.

pmc-12606108.title: In-silico discovery of druggable molecular signatures that drive dengue fever to severe dengue fever highlighting common pathogenesis through single-cell RNA-Seq analysis
pmc-12606108.creator: Md Al Noman, Md Abdul Latif, Md Foysal Ahmed, Md Shariful Islam, Md Al Amin Pappu, Md Sanoar Hossain, Md Bayazid Hossen, Tasfia Noor, Md Manir Hossain Mollah, Md Hadiul Kabir, Md Nurul Haque Mollah
pmc-12606108.description: Dengue, also known as dengue fever (DF), is an infection spread by mosquitoes. It infects over 400 million people globally each year. Sometimes DF progresses to severe DF (sDF) for which patients suffer from life-threatening complications including internal bleeding, failure of cardiovascular systems and death.

pmc-12656303.title: Lymph-Targeted Delivery of CUR-NLCs Enhances Oral Bioavailability: Evidence from a Double-Catheterized Rat Model
pmc-12656303.creator: Haoming Chi, Xiaorui Zhang, Zhiyuan Chen, Qiuyong Chen, Bo Yang, Hui Deng, Daojin Yu, Maria Camilla Bergonzi
pmc-12656303.description: Background/Objectives: Curcumin (CUR), a natural polyphenol with poor solubility and significant first-pass metabolism, shows extremely low oral bioavailability. Although CUR-loaded nanostructured lipid carriers (CUR-NLCs) have demonstrated potential in enhancing oral absorption, direct evidence regarding their intestinal lymphatic transport mechanism remains insufficient, and current understanding largely relies on indirect speculation.

pmc-12742099.title: Effects of multimodal mobile health interventions on cardiovascular risk factor management in patients with diabetes: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-12742099.creator: Yan Zhang, Xingqi Cao, LiJuan Huang, Yue Zhu, Liying Chen
pmc-12742099.description: ObjectivesDiabetes mellitus significantly increases the risk of cardiovascular disease (CVD). While mobile health (mHealth) interventions show promise, there is limited evidence on the efficacy of multimodal approaches for managing comprehensive CVD risk factors. This systematic review and meta-analysis aimed to evaluate the effectiveness of multimodal mHealth interventions in managing CVD risk factors in patients with diabetes.

pmc-13335759.title: Ultra‐Wide‐Field Noninvasive Imaging Through Scattering Media Via Physics‐Guided Deep Learning
pmc-13335759.creator: Lintao Peng, Mingwei He, Jeff Zhu, Sujit K Sahoo, Liheng Bian, Cuong Dang
pmc-13335759.description: Noninvasive imaging through scattering media is crucial for diverse applications but remains constrained by a narrow field of view (FOV). Although recent learning‐based methods have a larger FOV, they often require large‐scale real experimental datasets and struggle when the FOV is far beyond the optical memory effect (OME).

pmc-13427731.title: Differential effects of prior versus concomitant Steroid and Antibiotic Treatment on Immunotherapy Efficacy - A Pooled Analysis of the RAMONA, INTEGA, OPTIM, ELDORANDO, FORCE, TITAN-RCC and TITAN-TCC Trials of the German AIO Study Group

uslaw-usc-t31-s5362.title: 31 U.S.C. § 5362 — Definitions
uslaw-usc-t31-s5362.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t31-s5362.description: United States Code, Title 31 (Money And Finance); Chapter 53 (Monetary Transactions); Subchapter IV (Prohibition On Funding Of Unlawful Internet Gambling). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. In this subchapter: (1) Bet or wager.— The term “bet or wager”— (A) means the staking or risking by any person of something of value upon the outcome of a contest of others, a sporting event.
